free_text_notes.physician_note: 80-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, admitted 5/18 with left thalamic infarct with sensory deficits. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow. The patient practices fasting for religious reasons on certain days of the week. The clinical team was made aware and confirmed this does not conflict with the medication schedule.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. Patient worried about the cost of the new medication.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with husband. 5/21 18:00: Per pharmacy, atorvastatin changed from 20 mg daily to 80 mg daily. No documentation that the patient or family has been informed of the new dose. Husband normally works days but has taken the afternoon off to drive the patient home at the planned time. Patient asked to move the neurology clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge. Pharmacy hasn't finished; can the system update the active medication list for the atorvastatin change so the AVS prints correctly?
